items.title: 14.3.1 Natural sources (qudrat ki taraf se) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.3.1, printed page 307.

blocks.text: Natural particulate matter (PM, hawa mein tairte nanhe particles) mein zameen ki surface ki dhool, aur pollens, spores aur janwaron ke debris (tukre) jaise biological materials shamil hain. Volcano (aag aur lava ugalne wala pahar) phatne se atmosphere mein gases aur particulate matter (PM) ki bohat bari amount aa sakti hai. Thunderbolt (aasmani bijli) nitrogen ke oxides (NOₓ) ki kaafi amount paida karti hai.

Air pollution ke doosre natural sources yeh hain: samandar ki surface par algae, jo hydrogen sulphide (H₂S) gas chhorti hai; wind erosion (hawa se mitti ka urna), jo PM laata hai; aur humid (nam) ilaqe jaise swamps (daldal), peat bogs ya kam gehri jheelein, jo methane (CH₄) paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ka lafz
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'peat-bags' aur 'little deep lakes' chhapa hai; matlab peat bogs (daldali zameen jahan paudon ka malba jama hota hai) aur kam gehri jheelein hain.

blocks.prompt: Air pollutants ke teen bare natural sources batayein aur short explain karein.
blocks.explanation: Volcano gases, raakh aur dhool ki bari amount nikalte hain; aasmani bijli hawa ko itna garam karti hai ke nitrogen aur oxygen mil kar NOₓ banate hain; aur swamps jaise nam ilaqe paudon ke galne se methane chhorte hain. Dhool, pollens aur H₂S dene wali samandari algae aur misalein hain.

items: Natural: dhool, pollens, spores (PM); volcano (gases, PM); bijli (NOₓ); algae (H₂S); wind erosion (PM); swamps aur bogs (CH₄).
